components.text:
made with love and procrastination for wfc2

inspired by all those 'star fighter flying through something' presets. especially speeder 2k by unconed... of which this preset is pretty much a direct rip with updated model and dm

originally intended for a different camera and with texers for engine glow... but i changed my mind out of lazyness and similarity to another preset. and pressure for time of course :P

also originally intended to have static lightmap optimisation... after three attempts to code it i gave up... better to release something than nothing

the camera can be positioned anywhere looking in any direction, but the whittaker dm falls apart at angles opposite to what i intended.

enjoy
